notes.text: Codification Sections 73 and 73a, relating to Territory of Alaska, were omitted in view of admission of Alaska into the Union. Section 73, acts Aug. 24, 1912, ch. 387, § 5, 37 Stat. 513; Mar. 3, 1927, ch. 363, § 1, 44 Stat. 1392; Mar. 26, 1934, ch. 86, § 1, 48 Stat. 465, specified time of election of members of the legislature. Section 73a, act Mar. 26, 1934, ch. 86, § 4, 48 Stat. 466, empowered legislature to change date of elections.
